proposed_observation_schema.status: Design recommendation only;not runtime-validated or frozen
proposed_observation_schema.validation_gates: Strict enums/types,bounded unique IDs/sequence,optional unknown/null conditions,exact Unicode/whitespace,no raw-text inference. Contradictory feature declarations explicit. Validate independently before freezing executable schema.

feasibility.interpretation: Direct source-attributed claims,user-selected patterns and confound declarations,editorial matching/comparison,and unsupported factual outcomes remain four evidence layers. No personality/clinical diagnosis,third-party feelings or spirit identification from flame behavior.
feasibility.reuse: Narrow pure JSON/raw text/hash and immutable registry utilities only. Do not transfer Kent/coffee motifs,positions,timing or ancient lamp rite correspondences into candle conditions.
feasibility.digital: No renderer needed. Synthetic/hypothetical descriptions must remain labelled;screen flame is neither combustion nor an empirical fortune. Optional seeded creative layouts deferred;new protocol/vectors required if ever added.

physical_and_stopping: Software must work without lighting fire. Public Pamita pages prioritize physical confounds and stopping unsafe/oversized/smoky or overheating burns;cooled inspection differs from live handling. Record stopping as user declaration,not a ritual failure. Do not turn historical animal/blood/coercive material or invocations into operating steps. No camera/video proves absence of hazards or a physical cause.
